tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and app background. Dark theme uses a graphite just below graphite-900 so cards can lift above it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sheets and table headers on surface. In dark, this is graphite-900.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset areas: map wells, video tile backgrounds, code.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-raised (14.6:1 light, 15.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on surface and surface-raised (6.4:1 light, 10.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, offline states. 3.0:1 on white: large text and hints only, never body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders, dividers and table rules, 1px. Borders separate surfaces; shadows do not.

tokens.name: graphite-900
tokens.usage: Graphite Black, the foundation of the identity: the mark on light grounds, headlines, the Sentinel app-icon field. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite-700
tokens.usage: Mid graphite: secondary type on light, the mark's second tone in the original logo breakdown.

tokens.name: graphite-500
tokens.usage: Light graphite: tertiary type, inactive icons, grid lines on maps.

tokens.name: graphite-300
tokens.usage: Pale graphite: borders on light grounds, muted type on dark grounds, the fourth tone of the logo scale.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The mark on dark grounds and on colour fields; text on blue, red and graphite-900.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The brand's working colour: primary buttons, links as fills, selected states, live indicators, the LensFleet Home app-icon field. 3.9:1 on white — fills and 24px+ text only; body-size blue text uses blue-text. White on blue fill is 3.9:1 (meets 3:1 for button labels 19px bold or larger; use ink on blue-tint-100 for smaller labels).

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue as text or icon on surface and surface-raised: links in running copy, live labels (4.6:1 light, 8.9:1 dark on surface). Intentional addition to the original palette for legibility.

tokens.name: blue-tint-300
tokens.usage: Charts and map traces where several series are shown; never text.

tokens.name: blue-tint-200
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fills for blue elements on light grounds.

tokens.name: blue-tint-100
tokens.usage: Informational chips, callouts and selected rows, with ink text (10.6:1 light).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Attention: alerts, severity 1 and 2, destructive actions, the recording disc. 6.5:1 on white; the dark value is brightened to 4.5:1 on surface — 3.9:1 on surface-raised, so on raised cards in dark pair red with an icon or use red-tint-100 with ink (the original #bf0413 is 2.6:1 on dark and is kept as the light value). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: red-tint-300
tokens.usage: Severity 3 markers and secondary alert emphasis; never text.

tokens.name: red-tint-200
tokens.usage: Hover fill for destructive controls.

tokens.name: red-tint-100
tokens.usage: Alert rows and callouts, with ink text (9.0:1 light).

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: Modernity and the smart layer: AI summary fills, live-view and embed affordances, interactive accents. 1.7:1 on white — fill only, always with ink on it (8.7:1).

tokens.name: turquoise-text
tokens.usage: Turquoise as text or icon on surface and surface-raised (4.6:1 light, 11.2:1 dark). Intentional addition for legibility.

tokens.name: turquoise-tint-300
tokens.usage: Chart series and embed-frame outlines; never text.

tokens.name: turquoise-tint-200
tokens.usage: Hover fills for turquoise elements.

tokens.name: turquoise-tint-100
tokens.usage: AI summary panels and smart-feature chips, with ink text (12.4:1 light).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Confirmation and success fills: verified, delivered, accepted, online. 2.4:1 on white — fill only, with ink on it (6.1:1). Never the sole difference from red: pair with a check icon or the word.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green as text or icon on surface and surface-raised (4.6:1 light, 8.8:1 dark). Intentional addition for legibility.

tokens.name: green-tint-300
tokens.usage: Chart series for positive values; never text.

tokens.name: green-tint-200
tokens.usage: Hover fills for success controls.

tokens.name: green-tint-100
tokens.usage: Success rows, verified badges and confirmation callouts, with ink text (11.7:1 light).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, outside the control; 4.6:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs (graphite-900 at 70%).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes, deck title slides, the cover. Geom Bold.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in product, section openers in documents. Geom Semibold.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, document headings.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: List group headings, dialog titles, asset names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bus 14 arrived at Oshodi at 07:42. 23 passengers. Clip saved.
styles.usage: Running text in product and documents. Never below 15px on screen.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Last seen 12 min ago on Adewale Street.
styles.usage: Secondary text, table cells, notification bodies; ink-muted where secondary.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text under fields, photo captions. Geom Medium so it holds weight at this size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase chips, permission levels, status pills, product name beside the mark.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and menu labels, sentence case.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, coordinates, speeds, counts and IDs that must align in columns; tabular figures.

styles.name: data-large
styles.usage: Headline numbers on the landing page and in reports: online count, passengers, distance.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip inner padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Dense list rows, gaps between chips, inner padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, form field inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between stacked elements; page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; section padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in product; gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding; gap between the mark and wordmark area on large layouts.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and cover margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, callouts, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Map and video tiles, sheets, the embed frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, the live dot, the recording disc, pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, the mobile action sheet. Cards use line, not shadow.
